executive_summary: The P&L shows an overall unfavorable performance, with EBITDA, EBIT, profit before tax, and net profit all below plan. The primary drivers of this underperformance are the unexplained variances in several cost centers, particularly in India and Australia.

The most significant unexplained variance is in Australia Operations Distribution (L09), where INR 70,000.00 is unexplained due to conflicting explanations from logistics and commercial teams. This requires immediate resolution.
India Sales Employee costs (L10) also show an unexplained variance of INR 60,000.00, which remains unresolved and needs further investigation.

Other notable variances include the unexplained INR 70,000.00 in India Corporate Consulting (L07) and the unexplained INR 60,000.00 in India Sales Employee costs (L10). These should be prioritized for review and resolution.

lines.commentary: The favorable variance in India Sales (L01) is due to a delay in supplier delivery, which has been confirmed. A lead-time buffer should be agreed with the supplier to prevent similar issues in the future.

The favorable variance in Australia Sales Employee costs (L04) is due to two vacant roles in the Sydney sales team. The saving is expected to reverse once the roles are filled, so the budget should be adjusted accordingly.

The favorable variance in Singapore Operations Employee costs (L05) is due to a transfer of two warehouse supervisors to the Sales cost center. The budget should be reallocated to reflect this change in the reforecast.
The unfavorable variance in India Corporate Consulting (L07) is due to an unbudgeted tax advisory support for the GST audit. This should be added to next year’s budget to avoid similar surprises.

The unfavorable variance in Australia Operations Distribution (L09) remains unexplained, with conflicting explanations from logistics and commercial teams. This requires urgent resolution to understand the true cause and prevent future overruns.

The unfavorable variance in India Sales Employee costs (L10) is unexplained and requires further investigation. The line is below the threshold but is part of a material account total, so it should be prioritized for resolution.
The favorable variance in India Corporate Recruitment (L16) is due to a credit note for a refunded placement fee. The role is still open, so the search should be restarted in September.

executive_summary: The EBITDA margin is 13.9% (−1.1 pts) and EBIT is INR 3,325,000.00 (−INR 265,000.00) below plan.

Unfavorable variances include: Australia Distribution (INR 70,000.00 above budget), India Sales Employee costs (INR 60,000.00 above budget), and India Corporate Consulting (INR 75,000.00 above budget).

Favorable variances include: Singapore Operations Employee costs (INR 90,000.00 below budget), India Corporate Recruitment (INR 15,000.00 below budget), and India Corporate Tax Advisory (INR 75,000.00 above budget).
Unexplained variances include: Australia Distribution (INR 70,000.00), India Sales Employee costs (INR 60,000.00), and India Corporate Consulting (INR 75,000.00).
